title: Harkerware Currier & Ives "Homestead In Winter" 6 1/4" Saucer or Bread Plate
descriptionText: The Harkerware Currier & Ives "Homestead In Winter" 6 1/4" saucer or bread plate is a vintage collectible featuring a winter scene print by the renowned Currier & Ives franchise. The round plate with white and gold trim showcases a colonial style design with a theme of winter, making it a perfect addition to any winter-themed decor. Made of pottery with a diameter of 6.25 inches, this collector plate is a nostalgic piece that celebrates American culture and heritage.
